name: com.onlinechessanalyzer/pgn-analyzer
title: Online Chess Analyzer — PGN Parser, Opening Detector & FEN Inspector
description: Analyze standard chess PGN games with ECO opening detection and inspect FEN board positions.

tools.name: analyze_pgn_game
tools.description: Parse and validate a standard chess PGN game with chess.js, detect the ECO code and opening name, count moves, captures, checks, promotions, and castling, and return the final FEN, material balance, static evaluation, and game outcome.

pgn.description: Standard chess PGN text (with optional tag headers and SAN moves), e.g. '1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Bc5'.

includeMoves.description: Optional flag to include the parsed ply-by-ply move list (up to 200 plies). Defaults to false.

tools.name: inspect_fen_position
tools.description: Validate a Forsyth-Edwards Notation (FEN) chess position and return side to move, castling rights, en passant square, material counts and balance, legal move statistics, check/checkmate/stalemate/draw status, static evaluation, and optional legal moves.

fen.description: Standard 6-field chess FEN string, e.g. 'rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKBNR b KQkq - 0 1'.

includeLegalMoves.description: Optional flag to include all legal SAN moves plus capturing and checking move subsets. Defaults to false.
